description: This header file declares a function to create a command handler for restarting devices within the Cuttlefish Android project. It includes necessary headers and defines a factory function for creating command handler instances related to device restart commands.

methods.name: NewCvdDeviceRestartCommandHandler
methods.description: Factory function that creates and returns a unique pointer to a CvdCommandHandler responsible for handling device restart commands within the Cuttlefish project.
